  PROBLEM: The hard-failure loop omits the `workflow-log-analysis-test` job, so its failure leaves `release_hard_failure` false.
  WHY: A failed `workflow-log-analysis-test` could produce a SUPERSEDED header instead of FAILED (source labelled it MAJOR). Another reviewer (z-ai_glm-5_3-flash) found the omission consistent with the documented `all_supplemental_ok` policy at lines 7395-7397, so it disagrees that this is a bug.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:7453-7458 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `gh api ... 2>/dev/null || true` silently swallows lookup failures, so a failed lookup looks the same as "no newer run" in the logs.
  WHY: Operators cannot tell whether the SUPERSEDED lookup was attempted and failed. This was raised as a NIT and a hardening suggestion, with no behaviour change.
